The service

CuePrompt provides browser-based prompting, script and creator tools. Features may change, be unavailable in some browsers or regions, or depend on services run by your browser, device or a provider you select.

Your content and responsibilities

You retain responsibility for your scripts, recordings, uploads and any material you process. Do not use CuePrompt to process content you do not have the right to use, or for unlawful, harmful or infringing activity. Keep your own backup of important material; clearing browser data can remove locally stored content.

Third-party services

Smart Follow relies on your browser’s speech-recognition service. Optional AI writing and transcription requests are sent directly to the provider you configure. Those services have their own terms, privacy practices, availability and charges; you are responsible for reviewing them and for any charges you incur.

Availability and disclaimers

CuePrompt is provided as available. We work to keep it useful and reliable, but do not guarantee uninterrupted operation, compatibility with every device or browser, or that a feature will meet a particular purpose. Test recording and export workflows before relying on them for an important event.
